description: Fetches structured dataset metadata from the AWS Open Data Registry  (registry.opendata.aws) including descriptions, resources (S3 buckets, ARNs),  and AWS regions.

function.description:
要调用的功能名。可用值:
  - get_dataset: Fetch metadata for a specific dataset by path; 参数: dataset_path; 必填: dataset_path
  - list_datasets: List available datasets from the RSS feed; 参数: limit; 必填: 无

dataset_path.description:
Dataset path for get_dataset function. Can be provided as:
  - Short name: 'nasa-nasa-ssh'
  - Path with slash: '/nasa-nasa-ssh/'
  - Full URL: 'https://registry.opendata.aws/nasa-nasa-ssh/'

limit.description: Maximum number of datasets to return for list_datasets function.
